title: ChatEntry
description: One exchange of her history (since 1.3): what the user said, or the kind of the event she reacted to, and her reply.

sentAt.description: When it was said (ISO 8601 date and time).

type.description: user: the user's words are text; event: something happened, its kind is event.

text.description: The user's words, null for an event.

event.description: The kind of the event (node.connected, node.first_boot...), null for the user's words.

node.description: The node it came from, null when it came through the HTTP API or the server.

reply.description: Her reply, null when she has not answered (a failed or stopped turn).
